2) Email-only (fallback): We email a signed PDF to ap@brightwave.com and sarah.liu@novuscorp.com. This is fine for a small pilot but lacks the structured metadata advantages for automatic matching.

We will attach a sample UBL (sample-invoice-ubl.xml) that includes the reverse-charge line for your AP engineers to validate. Also attaching our portal onboarding checklist (portal_onboarding_instructions.pdf) — it includes the webhook URL and expected JSON/UBL fields.

Can you confirm: 
- Which option you prefer (Portal-first w/ email copy OR Email-only)

- Create a collector alias redwood-novus and provision a webhook (RW-4521)

Next steps: confirm preference and signatory; I will loop in Ben to provision the portal.
